name: Plan and Build
description: Structured planning and implementation process. Investigates the problem space, designs a plan, implements changes, validates, and commits. Use for any substantial feature, project, or multi-step task that benefits from upfront planning before execution.

goal.description: What to plan and build — feature, project, or multi-step task

steps.title: Context & Requirements Gathering
steps.description: Understand the requirements and baseline state of the target system for ${goal}. Identify constraints, dependencies, and objectives.
steps.accept_criteria: Requirements and baseline state documented. Constraints and dependencies listed. Enough context to form a plan.

steps.title: Technical Approach Planning
steps.description: Design the technical path to achieve ${goal}. Outline the changes, sequence of execution, risk mitigation, and validation criteria. Write the plan as a persistent artifact and present it for approval.
steps.accept_criteria: Plan exists with approach, risks, and acceptance criteria. Plan is presented for review.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.description: Execute the approved implementation plan for ${goal}. Construct or modify the necessary components to fulfill the technical design.
steps.accept_criteria: All planned changes implemented. Code follows conventions.

steps.title: Verification & Completion
steps.description: Verify that the implemented changes for ${goal} work as expected and introduce no regressions. Finalize the work by updating the system status and committing the changes.
steps.accept_criteria: Tests pass. No regressions. Changes committed.
